Anthony Trollope, Barchester Towers.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anthony-trollope/barchester-towers

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anthony Trollope, the author, died 1882 (citizenship: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland).

First publication of the text used: 1857 (SE colophon: 'Barchester Towers was published in 1857 by Anthony Trollope.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1857, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1952.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts): the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1882.
